vision.name: Black Energy Focus
vision.text:
(If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck by one of your effects, you may banish it to banish the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.)
[Attack] 1: Energy attack.
Lower a player's anger 1.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
HIT: Your opponent discards a card from their hand. If your MP does not have [Trait:Android], your opponent draws a card.
vision.note: card number area reads 'PREVIEW R5'. Inline Trait icon is the grey Red-Ribbon-style pictogram with an 'R' badge; identified as Android because Android 17 (S14 U38) carries exactly this icon plus the Earthling icon, and the FanZ CRD lists Android 17 as Android + Earthling
